_doc: Позы генерируются по одной картинке на кадр: сначала anchor (idle_south), затем каждая поза с anchor как референсом («the SAME character»). cell = размер ячейки спрайт-листа в тайлах [w,h] (32×48 px @1x → 128×192 @4x). rows — порядок сборки листа в sheet.mjs.

idle_south.prompt: standing still, facing the camera (south), relaxed arms, weight on both feet

idle_south_2.prompt: standing still, facing the camera (south), same pose as the reference but the chest slightly raised as if inhaling (subtle breathing frame)

idle_north.prompt: standing still, seen from behind (facing north, back to the camera), relaxed arms

idle_east.prompt: standing still, facing right (east), side view, relaxed arms

walk_south_1.prompt: walking toward the camera (south), mid-step, left foot forward, arms swinging

walk_south_2.prompt: walking toward the camera (south), mid-step, right foot forward, arms swinging the other way

walk_north_1.prompt: walking away from the camera (north, back visible), mid-step, left foot forward

walk_north_2.prompt: walking away from the camera (north, back visible), mid-step, right foot forward

walk_east_1.prompt: walking to the right (east), side view, mid-step, front leg forward

walk_east_2.prompt: walking to the right (east), side view, mid-step, legs crossing

sit_south.prompt: sitting on an invisible chair facing the camera (south), hands resting on an invisible desk in front, legs hidden behind the desk line, only upper body and knees visible

sit_type_1.prompt: sitting facing the camera (south) at an invisible desk, hands on an invisible keyboard, typing, hands slightly raised

sit_type_2.prompt: sitting facing the camera (south) at an invisible desk, typing, hands lowered onto the invisible keyboard (second animation frame)

sit_north.prompt: sitting on an invisible chair seen from behind (facing north), back visible, hands forward on an invisible desk

talk_1.prompt: standing facing the camera (south), talking, one hand raised in a small gesture

talk_2.prompt: standing facing the camera (south), talking, both hands slightly open in a gesture

alert.prompt: standing upright and alert facing the camera (south), arms straight down, wide eyes (waiting for approval)

think.prompt: standing facing the camera (south), one hand on the chin, thinking

celebrate.prompt: standing facing the camera (south), both arms raised up in celebration, happy face

error_dizzy.prompt: standing facing the camera (south), hunched over, dizzy face with small swirl eyes
